entries.content: AI Hack for Freedom III prep. Brief at docs/BRIEF.md. Pitches Fri Sep 25 1:30PM ET at NED DC. Judging: scale of problem, AI integration, technical execution, outside adoption. Captain problem unknown until event: build generic reusable kit only. No em-dashes, no commits, no local models on the prep laptop.

COORDINATOR BACKFILL (intel paused on session limit before storing). INTEL.md complete: 12 archetypes, 5 judge-memory items, STATUS. No III captains or judges announced. Tool traps: Breez needs emailed API key, OpenClaw needs Node 24.16+, Maple streaming-only and Pro plan. Coordinator second pass added Agent Camp/Finite TEE facts in COORDINATOR_FINDINGS.md section 8.

COORDINATOR BACKFILL (runbook paused on session limit before storing). All 5 runbook docs have STATUS sections; scripts/event-day-swarm.sh validated by tests/runbook (79 passed, 0 failed, ruflo never called). Untested by design: live launcher run, Ollama/llama.cpp commands, wrangler rollback, cloudflared, QR tools; all belong in the T-6 to T-4 dry run.

src/rails is a standalone ESM package on nostr-tools 2.25.2 (only runtime dep): keys plus NIP-49 backup, relay pool with per-relay ack summaries, notes, feeds, profiles, and NIP-17 gift-wrapped DMs using NIP-44 (no NIP-04 DM fallback), plus a NIP-47 NWC client (nip44_v2 negotiated, NIP-04 only if the wallet advertises nothing else), LNURL-pay with min/max and invoice-amount checks, and NIP-57 zap requests. 81 offline vitest tests and the tsc build pass, a read-only live smoke against wss://nos.lol passed, and a Node 22 undici WebSocket stack-overflow crash on unreachable relays was found and fixed; no real NWC wallet or LNURL server was tested.

Opsec kit done: docs/security/ACTIVIST_THREAT_CHECKLIST.md (threat actors, 5-MIN/2-HR/OUT OF SCOPE checklist, honest pitch claims, STATUS) and scripts/opsec-audit.sh with an 'opsec-audit: allow <reason>' marker, tested by tests/opsec (53 passed, 0 failed, macOS bash 3.2). Audit of the repo: src/starter clean; src/rails has 1 HIGH (NIP-19 test vector, needs the allow marker) and 11 MED source maps in src/rails/dist.

src/starter is a vanilla TS + Vite offline-first PWA with a streaming OpenAI-compatible LLM client (Ollama, llama.cpp, Maple Proxy on localhost:8080, custom), en/es/fa/ar/ru i18n with auto RTL and per-message dir=auto, IndexedDB data, JSON export, panic wipe, Docker/Caddy and Cloudflare Workers configs. Shell JS is 13.3 kB gzipped (coordinator measured 14.1 KB total); 47/47 tests pass, build passes, opsec audit PASS, coordinator verified 30 of 31 real-Chromium checks (the one failure is a Playwright navigator.onLine artifact).
